supporting_artifact_rule: Supporting files are permitted only if listed and hashed in the manifest and seal. No unlisted file may be present in the submitted archive.

manifest_and_seal.self_hash_rule: The seal may exclude only itself from its own hash inventory; every other submitted file must be listed exactly once.
manifest_and_seal.state_equality: Submission producer_status, manifest status and seal status must be identical.
manifest_and_seal.count_equality: Counts must be independently derivable from primary JSONL/JSON records and identical in submission, manifest and seal.

blindness_separation_rule: Blindness is provenance evidence for independent discovery. It is not a substitute for, and cannot veto or establish, the later greatest-element proof.

commercial_output_rules.baseline_ledger: Exactly one current primary-source record per official source claim plus explicit limitations and every discovered observable capability; no product may be omitted or merged.
commercial_output_rules.matrix: Exactly 3 baseline rows by 22 binding-axis columns = 66 planned cells. Phase 2 records evidence plans, architecture mechanisms, falsifiers and UNKNOWNs; it may not mark FOC-18 or T6 proved.
commercial_output_rules.evaluation_plan: Separately specifies mechanism-normalized, actual-product black-box and architecture-class proof tracks without credit for proprietary corpus quantity.

implementation_abstraction_rule.purpose: Prepare a total post-reveal mapping of the blind architecture onto the actual B0 repository without exposing B0 during Phase 2.
implementation_abstraction_rule.phase_2_limit: No B0 path, symbol or presumed implementation fact may be invented. Exact file/package/symbol changes are produced only after the sealed Phase-2 output and independent review, under B0-TRANSFORMATION-AND-REPOSITORY-DELTA-SPEC.json.
